title: Iran Forms Persian Gulf Data Authority to Punish AI Firm Backers
summary:
Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf announced a new oversight body to monitor the resources provided to artificial intelligence firms throughout the region. The newly created Persian Gulf Data Authority will track and restrict the flow of finance, equity, land, and energy to tech companies that Ghalibaf claims are aiding military invasions or the killing of children. He warned that any regional government or investment fund assisting such firms will face direct enforcement from the Iranian government.

The measures specifically target the infrastructure and financial pipelines of AI and data centers involved in warfare across the Persian Gulf. By threatening to penalize regional partners, Tehran seeks to isolate artificial intelligence ventures with alleged military ties through economic and infrastructural blockades.

JUST IN: Iran is threatening AI companies and data centers across the Persian Gulf.

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf announced plans for a “Persian Gulf Data Authority,” warning regional governments, investment funds and companies against supporting AI firms allegedly involved in military operations.

“No finance, equity, land and energy.”

He concluded with a direct threat:

“Assist them and face our enforcement.”

Are we about to see Iran target data centers in the Gulf again?
